percentiles: nearest-rank over all successful samples, process.hrtime.bigint from client request initiation

durable_submit_and_claim.scope: Warm = pool at ready 2 with nothing starting before each sample (waits outside the timed window); only standby-path samples are in the series. reply: request start -> durable claimed reply. control_ready: request start -> the job worker control endpoint record (claimed.json port+token, written before the reply) read by the client; v0.6 defined control readiness as this private endpoint record. control_answer (no gate): request start -> first authenticated inspect answered by the worker, one extra RPC while the worker spawns its child.

replenish.scope: claimed reply -> pool idle back at ready=2, observed by ping polling every 2 ms

complete_isolated_job.scope: request start -> terminal succeeded observed by inspect polling every 2 ms; job = node -e process.stdout.write(ok)

cold_worker_spawn.scope: PLOT_RESIDENT_READY=0: request start -> reply after a worker is spawned for this job and claims it

saturation.stable_rule: highest step R such that every step <= R had acceptance >= 99% and zero correctness failures after drain

warm_env_interact_python.scope: request start -> turn outcome over a fresh authenticated supervisor socket, proxied to the Environment Host

warm_env_interact_node.scope: request start -> turn outcome over a fresh authenticated supervisor socket, proxied to the Environment Host

bootstrap_cold.scope: fresh process: verify sha256, extract pinned Node archive into <root>/.grave/host, completion marker
